tests.goal: Confirm that {{MODEL_NAME}} ({{PROVIDER_NAME}}) can be selected, responds, titles the conversation and shows the correct hover tooltip

steps.action: Open the model picker and select {{MODEL_NAME}} under {{PROVIDER_NAME}}.
acceptanceCriteria: {{MODEL_NAME}} is listed and can be selected
{{MODEL_NAME}} replies without error
A conversation title is auto-generated

steps.action: Hover over {{MODEL_NAME}} in the model picker.
acceptanceCriteria: The provider eyebrow reads {{PROVIDER_NAME}}
Speed, intelligence, cost and context are all shown
Web Search is listed as supported only if the model supports it
A model with 5 cost chips says high cost

tests.goal: Confirm that a user's default model persists across refresh and multiple sessions

steps.action: Open the app and start a chat with a model (Model A).
Switch to another chat with a different model and ask a query.

acceptanceCriteria: Model A is still active
Model A is still the default model

tests.goal: Confirm that a model can be pinned and unpinned

steps.action: Open model selector and pin a model.
acceptanceCriteria: The pinned model appears above your list of historic chats, and acts as a shortcut to continue your latest chat (or start a new chat if you weren't actively chatting) with your chosen model
It disappears

tests.goal: Confirm that zero-cost models are tagged "Free" and suggested in the out-of-balance error

acceptanceCriteria: GPT 6 Luna shows a green "Free" pill
Terra, Sol and the other paid models do not
The balance gauge (bottom-left) does not drop

steps.action: Only if your balance is exhausted, send a message on a paid model.
acceptanceCriteria: The error says "You can still keep chatting using our free models: GPT 6 Luna."

tests.goal: Confirm that only the supported providers exist

steps.action: Open the model picker and look at the provider groups. The only providers should be: OpenAI Global, Anthropic Global, Anthropic Australia.
acceptanceCriteria: Only these providers are listed
No other providers or legacy models appear (e.g. no Gemini 2.5 models or old Anthropic models)

steps.action: Open Agent Builder and look at the provider names and model list.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the same providers are listed
The model lists match the main model picker

tests.goal: Confirm that the credit balance gauge is shown and updates as messages are sent

steps.action: Look at the bottom-left balance gauge.
acceptanceCriteria: It shows the current balance (e.g. $15/15)
The gauge decreases
The next available refill is shown
